messages:
Maria: Quick check — Nimbus Health is asking for a POC environment this week. Need checklist for creds + network so we can hand off to infra today.
Ash: copying the runbook below. TL;DR: we can do Hosted keys first, then Dedicated reserved pool if they need sustained throughput, and Private VPC if their security team insists on isolation.
Maria: timeline is tight. they want functional demo + security questionnaire done by Fri. any blockers?
Ash: blockers: (1) customer IP allowlist for test env, (2) KMS access for audit logs if we do Private, (3) pricing approval for Dedicated burst. otherwise fine.
Maria: can you paste the minimal provisioning steps? I’ll send to their infra lead.
Ash: sure — minimal steps for Hosted POC:

- Create API key scoped to the demo project (expire in 14d)
- Configure usage quota: 100k tokens / day
- Create demo model route -> use a smaller open model to control cost
- Share curl example and SDK snippet

curl example:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-mini","input":"hello"}'
```

Ash: Dedicated fallback notes:
- Need signed reserved capacity MOU (ops + sales)
- Set up pool with 2x A10 or equivalent for their traffic pattern
- Autoscale policy: base 1, burst to 4 for demo spikes
- Billing contact + billing PO

Ash: Private/VPC checklist (short):
- Customer to provide VPC peering or PrivateLink endpoint + egress rules
- IP ranges we need: 10.52.0.0/16 (example) — confirm overlap
- Service account + cross-account IAM role for provisioning
- KMS key ARN for encryption; we'll require decrypt permissions during deploy
- Audit log retention requirements

Maria: Kevin — any security red flags here?
Kevin: no showstoppers but ask Nimbus for SOC2 scoping questions: where logs live, who has access to key material, and whether they need HSM-backed KMS.
Kevin: also request their data classification level — if PHI, we need additional DPA clauses.

Maria: noted, I’ll add to the questionnaire. Jamal — can eng spin up a quick dedicated pool if they sign today?
Jamal: yes but provisioning lead time is ~6 hours once billing is cleared. for Private we need infra ticket + account link; that’s a same-day if we get their network details this morning.
Liz: I can own the handoff doc and send the secure questionnaire to Nimbus. Will attach the hosted key example and checklist.
Maria: opsbot — create provisioning ticket and track it.
OpsBot: Provisioning ticket created: #POC-3174 — assigned to @Jamal, priority: high. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/POC-3174 :white_check_mark:
Jamal: added a note on the ticket — need their CIDR and preferred key rotation window.
Maria: pricing question — they asked for a rough estimate for 2k users demoing concurrently for 2 hours. Ash, any quick calc?
Ash: rough: Hosted with gpt-mini -> ~0.5M tokens total -> $40-$80 depending on token pricing tier. Dedicated hourly maybe $200-350 for the reserved box while active. caveat: high variance if long dialogues.
Maria: perfect. I’ll include that as an estimate and call out TBD after we see real telemetry.
Kevin: if they push for Private, flag legal for DPA changes early. I’ll start the review.
Liz: sending questionnaire now, will cc @Kevin and @Jamal. Maria — I’ll update the ticket once they respond.
Maria: thanks team — ping me in thread if anything stalls. :thumbsup:
Ash: one more operational tip — enable prefix/KV caching on the demo route to cut token usage for repeated prompts.
Jamal: noted, I’ll enable caching on the route in the sandbox before handing off.
Maria: awesome — closing loop once Nimbus signs the MOU.
